target.statement: Top association rule for Cluster 1 (SAE Level 4 ADS): [Roadway Surface = Dry] + [Reporting Entity = Zoox, Inc.] -> [Make = Toyota] with support 0.08, confidence 1.00, lift 13.26
target.dataset: NHTSA Standing General Order (SGO) AV crash data, 2021-Jul 2024 (2,703 raw rows; 2,380 cleaned)

compute.basis: K-means + Apriori on ~2,380 rows is trivial compute; the effort is downloading/merging NHTSA SGO files and re-implementing the paper's undocumented cleaning, feature engineering, and clustering pipeline from scratch.

blockers: No code or configs released; full pipeline (missing-value handling, text-mined automation level, binning, label encoding, K-means seed/features) must be reverse-engineered
Exact cluster membership and rule counts depend on undocumented preprocessing choices, so the specific cell may not reproduce exactly
NHTSA SGO data is public but must be assembled from multiple downloadable files
title: Data-Driven Analysis of Crash Patterns in SAE Level 2 and Level 4 Automated Vehicles Using K-means Clustering and Association Rule Mining
